summary: Israeli fighter jets and tankers conducted an attack-style sortie over Syria and Iraq to Iran's border, which Israel called a drill but US sources suggest may have been intended to provoke Iranian fire. Netanyahu declared regime overthrow as the only way to eliminate the Iranian nuclear threat, while Katz warned Iran would "burn" if it attacks Israel. Meanwhile, Iranian ballistic missile transporters were observed moving near launch sites in Fars and Lorestan provinces.

Katz threatened Iran will "burn" if it attacks Israel; Iranian regime staged street theater in Tajrish Square depicting US president in a cage. (Source: @amitsegal/66038, @shin_persian/11350)

sections.threat_assessment: Israel has demonstrated capability to penetrate Syrian and Iraqi airspace en masse to Iran's doorstep, signaling credible strike option. Iranian missile dispersal suggests anticipation of attack or preparation for retaliation. Netanyahu's explicit regime-change rhetoric and Katz's "Iran will burn" threat raise escalation ladder. US assets repositioning to CENTCOM and Persian Gulf F-35A emergency indicate heightened American readiness. The convergence of Israeli offensive posturing, Iranian missile movements, and US force augmentation creates a volatile window for miscalculation.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's unexplained Jeddah air traffic hold suggests Gulf states are implementing precautionary airspace measures. Iranian propaganda theater in Tehran signals regime's domestic mobilization. Lebanese front remains active with daily Israeli strikes, but no major Hezbollah response reported. Syrian and Iraqi silence on Israeli overflight implies either tacit acceptance or inability to contest. No Arab diplomatic initiatives visible in current traffic.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Israeli sortie over Syria/Iraq to Iran border represents the most significant force projection since October 2024; US characterization as possible provocation warrants scrutiny. Iranian missile movements at Najm Abad and Pouneh tunnel indicate operational activity at known IRGC missile bases. IDF voting logistics inadvertently confirmed precise forward deployment numbers: 40 Gaza outposts, 9 Syria outposts, numerous Lebanon positions. US tanker fleet return and E-3 deployment suggest sustained CENTCOM buildup. Jeddah air traffic hold remains unexplained but coincides with regional tension spike.
